title: Template Version Watcher
description: On startup and once daily, check templates/scenarios/<template>/template.json::version against each golden's pinned version. When ahead, mark all manifests for that golden stale and surface a notification.

requirements.title: Watcher scheduler + version reader
requirements.description: Background loop in api/internal/templatewatcher: runs on process start and at a daily cadence, reads template versions from disk, compares to golden registry, persists stale flags. No automatic regeneration.
